notes.title: Game update
notes.notes:
All the minor bugs in the game have been now cleaned! 

Please, leave a comment if you find any other remaining issue. I've also added the "bara" tag to the store page so people are more aware of what kind of game this is (not only a Visual Novel, but a bara one).

For the ones who commented they would like more content like this from Ertal Games... I'm sorry, but bara is not really my cup of tea, hahaha! I just wanted to make a short game about gladiators, since I live in a town with a huge Roman heritage and I've seen many gladiators reenactments in my life, and they are really cool!

However, you can follow the artist's itchio, since he specializes in bara art and sometimes collaborates with other indie game devs; I'm sure you will find interesting stuff! https://wolfscade.itch.io/

Thank you again for playing Blood and Lust! Don't forget to leave a review if you like it, even if it just says "nice game" ːsteammockingː

notes.title: Update with fixed bug!
notes.notes:
Everything should be working fine now, guys! 

I haven't tested it on Mac, so if any Mac user has a problem with the achievements, please let me know ;)

notes.title: Release date delayed a few days!
notes.notes:
Sorry for the inconvenience! We are currently making a video trailer for the game, since it's a requirement for the approval of the Steam page. 

Blood and Lust will be live as soon as the video is ready! ;)

The game is also being translated to Polish, so perhaps we'll wait until the translation is finished and can be added to the game, too; if we see that would delay the release too much, then we'll add it later as an update.

See you very soon!
